argv:
cat > suite.json <<'JSON'
{
  "schemaVersion": "2",
  "mode": "agentWorkflow",
  "reportingMode": "standard",
  "suite": {"id":"s_arithmetic_validation", "name":"Arithmetic server regression"},
  "target": {"servers":[{"name":"arithmetic-validation"}]},
  "defaults": {"judge":{"enabled":false},"model":"anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5","iterations":1,"passThreshold":1,"validity":{}},
  "cases": [{
    "id":"c_add_2_3", "title":"2 plus 3 returns 5",
    "steps":[
      {"id":"call_add","kind":"toolCall","serverName":"arithmetic-validation","toolName":"add","arguments":{"a":2,"b":3}},
      {"id":"assert_no_errors","kind":"assert","assertion":{"type":"noToolErrors"}},
      {"id":"assert_sum","kind":"assert","assertion":{"type":"toolResultMatches","toolName":"add","path":"/sum","patterns":["^5$"]}}
    ]
  }]
}
JSON
npx mcpjam cloud eval validate --file suite.json --no-telemetry > validation.json
cat validation.json
npx mcpjam cloud eval run --file suite.json --project project_fixture --wait --wait-timeout 60000 --out eval-report.json --no-telemetry > run.json
cat run.json
